description: Nottingham Bus Route Optimisation Instances is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Philipp Heyken Soares. The present datasets contain instance data and results which were presented in the publications "An Adaptive Scaled Network for Public Transport Route Optimisation" by Philipp Heyken Soares, Christine L. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
